timer.title: Timer
timer.clock-switch: Also offer timers in the Clock app
timer.clock-hint: Shows a button on every timer that starts the Clock app's timer. It rings on a locked phone, too. This device needs the shortcut set up once, see below.
timer.clock-setup: How to set up the shortcut
timer.clock-step-1: Open the Shortcuts app and tap "+" at the bottom right.
timer.clock-step-2: Change the name at the top to "KH Timer" (exactly, or adjust the name below).
timer.clock-step-3: Add the action "Get Numbers from Input" with the source "Shortcut Input".
timer.clock-step-4: Add the action "Start Timer"; duration = the number from step 3, unit minutes. Done.
